name: Eventide Threshold
introDiscord:
The light changes.

Not darker.

Not brighter.

Permanent sunset.

Every direction ends in the same violet horizon.
introTwitch:
The light changes.

Not darker.

Not brighter.

Permanent sunset.

Every direction ends in the same violet horizon.

eventide-threshold-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Eventide Threshold.

left.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Sunset has lasted eleven hours.

Beginning to suspect sun is decorative.'

right.message: A cache glows beneath endless dusk.

forward.message: An Eventide Behemoth emerges from the horizon itself.

eventide-threshold-depths.prompt: Deeper within Eventide Threshold, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A Behemoth walks through a sunset that should be miles away.

right.message: A warm twilight current restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message:
Star Candies shine like the first stars of evening.

Except evening never finishes.

eventide-threshold-threshold.prompt: Near Boundary Without Dawn, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A coffer rests at the edge of the unmoving horizon.

right.message: An Eventide Behemoth steps from its own sunset-shadow.

forward.message: Shizuki's old resting place glows under permanent twilight.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Boundary Without Dawn
boss-antechamber.prompt: Boundary Without Dawn darkens by one impossible shade.

bossPromptDiscord:
Boundary Without Dawn darkens by one impossible shade.

Something enormous moves where night should begin.

Use /yes to enter or /no to continue waiting for morning.
bossPromptTwitch:
Boundary Without Dawn darkens by one impossible shade.

Something enormous moves where night should begin.

Use !yes to enter or !no to continue waiting for morning.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Boundary Without Dawn. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The horizon rises on four massive limbs.

Endless Dusk Behemoth reveals itself!

completionText:
The creature fades.

Far ahead, for the first time, you see one star beyond the horizon.

There is more.
